frequency_question: How often does a nominated executive agency head receive a confirmed Senate floor vote within a comparable short window among comparable nominations?
membership_rule: Includes formal nominations of Senate-confirmed executive branch positions where the Senate acted via floor vote within 30 days of submission; excludes recess appointments and nominations withdrawn before committee action.
coverage_note: 10 named from recent comparable major executive nominations; believed representative of fast-tracked executive confirmations when majority party aligns.
known_gaps: Does not account for intense partisan obstruction specifically targeting FDA commissioners if drug approval controversies are present.
validity_reason: Valid through the current presidential term dynamics and Senate confirmation rules.
